messages.subject: ShinyR server in production
parts:
I'm getting close to running a shinyR server in 'production' (actually internally, but the idea is that it is live & the apps we produce will have users depending on them). 
This would be the last evaluation phase before moving onto Shiny server pro. 
Does anyone have any tips for running in prod? 
It seems to me that a shiny app is inordinately slow running on a shiny server (as opposed to running locally from rstudio on an equivalent machine) - haven't investigated much, but I'm sure I'll need to in this next phase. 
Also - I've noticed that apps that are left open tend to time out & grey-screeen.

messages.author: 5ab11db47365dff1
messages.subject: Re: ShinyR server in production
parts:
I use Shiny Server free version on a production site without issues.  We proxy through nginx.  Running ubuntu 14.04 and latest packages.  It's plenty fast -- not noticably slower than running locally.  This is on AWS on a 2 core EC2 instance.  I've also run it on an 8core CPU on Linode.  Both run fine.

It really should not be inordinately slow.  What kind of hardware are you running on?
